title: SHEIN on Trustpilot: score, complaints and what the numbers show
seoTitle: SHEIN on Trustpilot: score and complaints
description: SHEIN has 3.8 out of 5 on Trustpilot from 353,689 reviews. What the score shows, the complaints about parcels and refunds, and why the profile is global.
metaDescription: SHEIN on Trustpilot in November 2026: TrustScore 3.8 from 353,689 reviews, 59% five stars, 18% one star. Complaints about parcels and refunds, and what the score misses.
imageAlt: Model in a brown jacket and jeans with a phone and bag by a stone wall in an official SHEIN photo. Cover text: “SHEIN reviews: What do they say?” and “Delivery and refunds”, with referral code 4CW5Y.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: SHEIN has a TrustScore of 3.8 out of 5 on Trustpilot, labelled “Great”, from 353,689 reviews. Most are five stars, but the one-star reviews arrive fast and cluster on parcels that never arrived and refunds that are late or denied. The profile is global, so the score does not say how an order to your country will go.

contentSections.heading: What the score measures
paragraphs: The TrustScore is the profile’s rating on Trustpilot. In November 2026, SHEIN had 3.8 with the label “Great”, from 353,689 reviews, and 14,994 of them were posted in the last 12 months.

contentSections.heading: Three readings that change the picture
paragraphs: First, the invitations. The store asks for a review after purchase, and a paid profile that invites reviews attracts many short five-star ones. The 3.8 adds years of reviews and invitations together.

Second, the recent flow. In our reading, the one-star reviews arrived much faster than the five-star ones: the 40 newest one-star reviews fit inside one week, while the 40 newest five-star reviews cover three months.
Third, replying is not resolving. The store replied to 98% of the negative reviews, usually within 24 hours. A public reply does not show that the problem was solved.

contentSections.heading: What the complaints say
paragraphs: We read the 40 newest one-star reviews, posted between November 16 and 23, 2026. All were unprompted, and the store replied to 35 of them. The themes:
bullets: Delivery (11): a parcel never received, sent to the wrong address or to a locker nobody asked for, or marked as delivered without arriving.
Returns and refunds (9): a return that arrived but was not refunded, items said to be missing from the return, slow refunds.
Items missing or swapped in the parcel (6).
Product and size (5): different from the listing, quality, sizes that run large.
Service, account and charges (9): support by bot only, blocked accounts, extra fees, points games.

postParagraphs: These are themes from 40 reviews, not a measure of how often an order goes wrong. They show where to look: the tracking after dispatch, the proof of delivery, the return receipt and the refund request.

contentSections.heading: What the praise says
paragraphs: We read the 40 newest five-star reviews, which cover three months (August 29 to November 19, 2026): 10 came from the store’s automatic invitation, 1 from a link and 29 were unprompted. The praise is about:
postParagraphs: Some of these reviews do not mention the store at all. We did not read the four- and two-star reviews, which count toward the score too. Praise and complaints describe different moments of the purchase: the catalogue and the price on one side, the parcel that never arrived on the other. The score adds both together.

contentSections.heading: Trustpilot: who writes the reviews, and from where
paragraphs: The www.shein.com profile combines reviews from customers in many countries and does not split the score by country. The page also notes that the company has received attention from regulatory bodies. Trustpilot says it presents that note neutrally and only for information, and we report it the same way: it is on the profile, and the score does not explain it.
For an order to your country, check on SHEIN’s official site or app for your country: shipping cost, delivery time, import VAT or customs duties, and the return rules.

contentSections.heading: Can you trust SHEIN based on Trustpilot?
paragraphs: Going by Trustpilot, the store has a 3.8 out of 5, with more five-star reviews than any other kind and 18% one-star, and it replies to 98% of the negative ones. Two things hold the score back: the fast one-star complaints about parcels and money, and a profile that is global. The score shows how the store treats its customers overall, not how a given order will reach your country.
contentSections.emphasis: The score tells you how SHEIN treats its customers as a whole, and the complaints show where the risk sits: the parcel and the refund. Keep the proof of both.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
paragraphs: Keep the payment receipt and the tracking number: they show what you paid and where the parcel stopped.
If the parcel does not arrive or the item is wrong, request the refund through the store’s own channel, on the site or in the app, and keep the return receipt if you send something back.
To see who runs SHEIN and which country the company is from, read [Is SHEIN legit and safe?](/en/reviews/is-shein-legit-and-safe).
If you have decided to buy, the [SHEIN page](/en/coupons/shein) leads to the official site.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does SHEIN have a good score on Trustpilot? The TrustScore is 3.8 out of 5, labelled “Great”, from 353,689 reviews; 59% are five stars and 18% are one star.

What are the most common complaints about SHEIN? In the 40 newest one-star reviews we read, the themes were delivery, returns and refunds, missing or swapped items, product and size, and service, accounts and charges. These are themes from a sample, not counts for the whole profile.
Does SHEIN reply to negative reviews? According to the profile, the store replied to 98%, usually within 24 hours, and may use AI in its replies. A reply does not show whether the problem was solved.

Does the Trustpilot score apply to my country? No. The profile is global and does not split reviews by country. Check delivery time, shipping cost, import taxes and returns on the official site or app for your country.

What is the 4CW5Y code and how do I use it? It is Cecília’s referral code, not a checkout coupon. Open SHEIN through the link on this site, or search 4CW5Y in the SHEIN app or website: it opens a selection of products, promotions and discounts, and SHEIN decides how much and on which items.

You keep the receipt and tracking number, and you know how to ask for a refund through the store’s channel.
skipIf: You need the item on a fixed date, because the most common one-star complaint is a parcel that never arrives.
You do not want to depend on slow customer service, which one-star reviews often mention.
